title: Rabbit and Tanuki
text: “Ahh… so annoying, having to wait until night.”

It was a tent set up in town, I say. They were preparing for tonight’s circus performance, but right now everyone was on break. Amid all that, Panda sat sprawled in a chair with her feet up, thoroughly slacking off. Father, meanwhile, appeared to be near Panda, sorting through the ledgers together with the Siltvelt envoy. Crocodile Guy was nowhere to be seen. Was he off training with Éclair, perhaps? Wolf also seemed to be looking over the ledgers, indeed. Word was he’d become capable of clerical work now too. Given how things had gone up until now, plenty of people probably found it jarring to see him doing intellectual work in his beastman form.
“Father, I’m back!”
“Oh, welcome back, Motoyasu-kun. Yuki-chan was looking for you, you know?”
“Oh, is that so? Well then, I’ll go for a quick run with Yuki-chan and the others later. Do you have any plans, Father?”
“Ah, I’m about to start prepping the food stalls soon. After tonight’s circus, I’ve also got some slave purchasing to do, so I’ll probably be a bit late.”
Lately, they’d more or less finished rescuing most of Big Sister’s friends. Even so, Father seemed to remain busy with the circus and the slave trade.
“So—”
Father looked up and noticed the beastified Rabbit Guy standing behind me. Noticing the gaze, Rabbit Guy stepped forward, looking rather timid about it.
“Wait, is that… Theo?”
“Y-yes. Iwatani-sama… these people latched onto me, insisting they could cure my illness, and forced treatment on me… so… h-how does it look?”
“Ohh…”
“Well, this is certainly…”
Before Father could answer, Wolf and the Siltvelt envoy both let out sounds of their own.
“Forced treatment—was that even safe?”
“No problem at all. I said I could do it, and I’ve gone and demonstrated it, haven’t I?”
“How about that!” Rafumi declared, puffing out her chest proudly.
“I already knew Rafumi-chan was amazing, but… a rabbit and a tanuki, huh.”
Somehow, I got the feeling that Father’s mind had just conjured up the old tale of Kachi-Kachi Mountain.
“He’s not gradually going to turn into Rafumi-chan, is he?”
“That’s exactly what I was wondering when I asked.”
“Shield Hero, you too? Master and slave, thinking the exact same thing. There’s no way it’ll turn out like that.”
“Well, coming from a world where humans are the only race, I have no idea how far this transformation range goes—I mean, Ren ended up turning into an inult, after all.”

True enough, indeed. Honestly, given Big Sister’s case too, I figured there was probably no limit to how far this transformation range could stretch. Take the Shieldfreeden pig among Takt’s pigs, for instance—she had a dragon form in addition to her beastman form. I’d also heard that Tiger Girl’s older brother eventually gained a similar kind of transformation. As for Older Sister, even after receiving Father’s modification treatment, she still retained the ability to transform into that form of hers. In a way, you could call that a kind of Raph-species transformation too, I suppose. Even if her form did look rather like a sea lion.
“I’m glad you’ve managed to fully transform into a beastman, Theodore-sama. Congratulations on overcoming your hereditary illness.”
“Vow. Congratulations.”
“I’m glad you were able to properly become a beastman. So, how does it feel, being able to fully transform now?”
“It happened so easily that it honestly hasn’t quite sunk in yet.”
“This one here’s been feeling left behind by the other slaves lately, sighing about how he wanted Shield Hero to pet his fluff.”
“Father. Behold, a rabbit. Well? Which do you prefer—tanuki or rabbit?”
In my mind, I could almost hear Big Sister protesting, “Why bring up tanuki all of a sudden!? Is this some kind of challenge to me!?” But no, that wasn’t it at all.
“That’s not it at all, I keep telling you! You people are so persistent! And anyway, calling it ‘tanuki’—are you trying to drag Rafumi-san into this comparison too!?”

“Hm? You want me to join in too? Very well. I could let you experience the feel of my supremely fluffy, top-quality fur, if you like. If you’re so eager to compete, that is. Don’t come crying to me when you lose, hah!”
Rafumi struck an odd pose, running a hand through her hair with a sidelong glance.
“What are those two even doing.”
“I think they just want me to appreciate how nice their fur is?”
“Ah, so it’s the same as you checking my coat to worry about my health, huh? Though the old man and my parent’s fur got weirdly fluffy and glossy.”
“Vow.”

Not to be outdone, Wolf pulled out a comb and ran it through his hair as if grooming himself. It looked exactly like the pose of a delinquent fixing his hair. As if he had a pompadour he was straightening out.
“Something’s turned weirdly awkward here… Wolf, you don’t need to compete like this, acting your age would be nice.”
“I’d rather you call me ‘you’ casually, or ‘kimi,’ or ‘omae,’ instead of ‘anata.’ Naofumi-sama, it feels a bit distant.”
Wolf answered with a sharp, serious expression, placing a hand on Father’s face as he did so. Behind him, the Siltvelt envoy wore a strained, wry smile.
“Wolf?”
“Sure, I might be older than you, but I want you to treat me the same as always. Vof… heh heh.”

Hmm… I got the feeling Wolf was making some strange sort of advance. Not to be outdone myself, I stepped forward, swiftly inserting myself between them to firmly redirect Father’s attention over to me.
“Father, I’d like you to hear me out over here.”
“Huh? Oh, right. What is this weirdly feminine atmosphere going around? Am I just imagining it…?”

Father tilted his head, puzzled. Was there really such an element present here? Now then, who among this group should I be championing? Personally, I wanted Panda to be the one to relieve Father of his virginity, so pushing things along quickly the way Older Sister might have was a fine option—but this time, there was the matter of resolving Rabbit Guy’s troubles to consider. More than anything, rabbits are cute, I say. So, I decided to push that angle first.
“Rather than Rafumi, why not brush Rabbit Guy and thoroughly enjoy his coat instead?”
Getting sighed at would be a hassle, after all.
“Come on, Rabbit Guy. Get over here already.”

There was also the matter of repaying him for standing in as my stunt double to get kicked during the Filo-tan Recreation Project. If he wanted Father to pet him, then he ought to get petted to his heart’s content.
“Hey. Don’t ignore me.”
“Rafumi, stand down. Father pets Raph-species plenty on other occasions, so this time, yield the spot.”
“Hmph. Fine, I suppose. That’s the whole point this time, after all. Now, go on.”
Rafumi crossed her arms and gave Rabbit Guy a kick in the back, shoving him toward Father.
“Ow! Honestly, none of you ever listen to a word people say!”
“Now, now. Huh… so this is Theo’s beastman form. Is it okay if I touch you?”
“Y-yes.”

Asked whether it was fine to be touched, Rabbit Guy nodded obediently. Then, to make himself easier to pet, he lowered his hips and thrust his head forward. He also held out his arms, as if practically begging to be petted there too. It was the sort of gesture that said, “touch me anywhere, please.” Hmm… offering up the head first is important, indeed. I too had learned the art of coquettish fluff-time behavior, taught directly by Chick. Back when I was a usaunny trying to get Father to pet me, I’d offer up my head and make my eyes sparkle as much as possible. Rabbit Guy, whatever happened to those sparkly eyes I taught you? Come on, there are necessary moves to be made here. And of course, cutely nuzzling one’s face afterward too.
“Ohh…”

Father ran his hands through Rabbit Guy’s fluffy coat, checking it out. Starting from the face, naturally—after stroking the cheeks and forehead, next comes gently touching the ears. I happen to know firsthand just how pleasant that touch feels. And of course, if you offer up the spot you want petted, Father is exactly the sort to pet you right there. I myself study day and night to discern exactly what petting spots Filolial-samas desire. Becoming a usaunny made me understand all the more just what a demanding skill set this truly requires.
